simple.meaning: properly, curative , i.e. literally (concretely) a medicine , or (abstractly) a cure ; figuratively (concretely) deliverance , or (abstractly) placidity
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מַרְפֵּא (H4832) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.

definitions.short: properly, curative , i.e. literally (concretely) a medicine , or (abstractly) a cure ; figuratively (concretely) deliverance , or (abstractly) placidity
definitions.full: H4832. marpe מַרְמֵּה מַרְמֵּא, noun masculine Eccl 10:4 healing, cure, health (usually figurative); — absolute מַרְמֵּא Jer 14:19 +, מַרְמֵּה 8:15 ; construct מַרְמֵּא Prov 15:4 ; — 1 healing, cure , of national woes, Jer 8:15 ; 14:19 b (|| שָׁלוֺם ), 36:6 (+ אֲרֻכָה ); especially מ לָנוּ ׳אֵין 14:19 a there is no cure for us , מ לְאֵין ׳עַד 2Chr 36:16 . 2 figurative of person , health, profit , Prov 4:22 (|| חַיִּים ), 12:18 ; 13:17 ; 16:24 ; with spiritual implication Malachi 3:20; מ ׳אֵין 6:15 = 29:1 ; מ ׳לֵב 14:30 a mind of health (healthy, composed, mind), compare ׳מ alone = composure Eccl 10:4 ; ׳מ לְשׁוֺן Eccl 15:4 healing of the tongue , = a soothing tongue (Toy). 3 literally, of disease , מ ׳לְאֵין 2Chr 21:18 .
